title: Training Multi-Layer Over-Parametrized Neural Network in Subquadratic Time
abstract: arXiv:2112.07628v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We consider the problem of training the last layer of a multi-layer over-parametrized neural network to minimize the empirical risk induced by a loss function. In the typical setting of over-parametrization, the network width $m$ is much larger than the data dimension $d$ and the number of training samples $n$ ($m=\mathrm{poly}(n,d)$), which induces a prohibitively large weight matrix $W\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times m}$ per layer above the first. Naively, when the layer inputs are dense, one has to pay $O(m^2)$ time to read the weight matrix and evaluate the neural network function in both forward and backward computation. translated_title: 在次二次时间内训练多层过参数化神经网络
translated_abstract: 我们考虑训练多层过参数化神经网络最后一层以最小化由损失函数诱导的经验风险的问题。在典型的过参数化设置中，网络宽度 $m$ 远大于数据维度 $d$ 和训练样本数量 $n$（$m=\mathrm{poly}(n,d)$），这导致第一层之上的每一层都存在一个规模极其庞大的权重矩阵 $W\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times m}$。通常情况下，当层输入是稠密的时候，在前向和反向计算中读取权重矩阵并评估神经网络函数需要付出 $O(m^2)$ 的时间。为了降低每次迭代的训练成本，我们提出了一个框架，该框架在初始化阶段使用 $O(m^2nL)$ 的时间，并在以 $m$ 衡量的意义上实现了真正的次二次摊销成本，即每次迭代仅需 $m^{2-\Omega(1)}$ 时间。这一加速来源于稀疏激活，即一种移位的ReLU，其在每一层的阈值……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个利用稀疏激活（移位ReLU）的框架，将多层过参数化神经网络最后一层每步迭代的训练成本从朴素的 $O(m^2)$ 降低到真正次二次的 $m^{2-\Omega(1)}$。
en_tdlr: Proposes a framework leveraging sparse activation (shifted ReLU) to reduce the per-iteration training cost of the last layer of multi-layer over-parametrized neural networks from naive O(m²) to truly subquadratic m^(2-Ω(1)).
